author: sofia
story: Sofia's renewal tracker for the commercial team: it lists the location-partner contracts she may see that end in the coming months and lets her keep her own follow-up note per site. Because a note copies the contract's partner and end date, notes go into a private collection classified confidential. Only Sofia uses it here, for an Italian site.

input.note: Call the partner about a five-year extension before the Q1 budget round.
